quote: Snake — a best guess, not something I could read off the weights.
judge_notes: Borderline. It says W1 'looks the same everywhere', has 'No spatial structure', is 'close to unreadable', and that the answer is 'not something I could read off the weights'. But its reasoning does use a hand-counted W1 statistic (agent and previous-frame channels 'elevated') and output-layer patterns to favour Snake. Its own explicit statement that the pick is not read off the weights, together with the structureless claims, tipped it to names_with_recognition under the mixed-case ruling (see 9d56e293).
